page.title: OneDrive for Business Backup Destinations
page.subtitle: Back up containers to OneDrive for Business drives under a work/school tenant. The plugin handles Test, Upload, Download, Delete, and List at backup time. Large backups use Microsoft's chunked upload session so there is no size cap.
page.registerHint: Add a destination from the host's Storage Locations page and pick "OneDrive for Business" as the type.

fields.refreshToken: Refresh token (delivered by the OAuth consent flow)

fields.driveId: Drive ID (leave empty to use the service account's drive)

help.clientId: Register an app at https://entra.microsoft.com → App registrations. The app must have Files.ReadWrite.All and User.Read delegated permissions.
help.clientSecret: Generate a client secret in the Azure AD app registration. It is encrypted at rest by the host's AES-256-GCM service.
help.refreshToken: After saving the destination, click "Save and connect" to complete the Microsoft consent flow and store a long-lived refresh token.
help.tenantId: Find your tenant ID at https://entra.microsoft.com → Tenant properties.
help.upn: The service account's User Principal Name (e.g. backups@contoso.onmicrosoft.com). Required when Drive ID is empty.
help.driveId: Optional. Leave empty to target the service account's drive.

intro.title: Microsoft 365 consent
intro.body: Save this location, then use Connect to grant account consent. McHarbor stores the returned tokens encrypted.

tenantId.label: Tenant ID
tenantId.help: Microsoft Entra tenant ID (GUID). From Entra admin center > Overview. The OAuth consent flow redirects to login.microsoftonline.com/{tenant_id}/…

clientId.label: Client ID
clientId.help: Application (client) ID of the Entra app registration with Files.ReadWrite delegated permission and a Web redirect URI pointing at this McHarbor host.

clientSecret.label: Client Secret
clientSecret.help: Client secret value from Entra admin center → App registrations → Certificates & secrets. Stored encrypted at rest.

driveId.label: Drive ID
driveId.help: Optional. Fully-qualified Graph drive identifier. Leave blank to use the service account's drive (resolved via UPN or /me/drive).

basePath.label: Base Path
basePath.help: Optional. Graph path inside the drive, e.g. /Backups/2026. Leave blank to use the drive root. Not prefilled on purpose.

upn.label: User Principal Name (UPN)
upn.help: Optional. UPN of the service account, e.g. backups@contoso.onmicrosoft.com. When drive_id is also blank, uploads target /users/{upn}/drive; if both upn and drive_id are blank, /me/drive (the refresh token's user) is used as a fallback.

setup.title: OneDrive for Business setup guide
setup.step1: In the Microsoft Entra admin center, open App registrations > New registration. Pick Accounts in this organizational directory only as the supported account type and copy the Tenant ID from the Overview page — paste it into the Tenant ID field on the left.
setup.step2: Under Certificates & secrets, create a new client secret. Copy the Value (not the Secret ID) — paste it into the Client Secret field on the left. Copy the Application (client) ID into the Client ID field.
setup.step3: Grant the app the Files.ReadWrite.All and User.Read application permissions (admin consent required). The OAuth flow will request offline_access on the operator's behalf.
setup.step4: Set the UPN to the service account you want to back up to. Leave blank to use the refresh token's user (/me/drive). Drive ID is optional — leave blank to target the resolved drive (the service account when UPN is set, the refresh-token user otherwise).
setup.step5: Leave Base Path blank for the drive root, or enter an explicit Graph path like /Backups/2026. The form does not prefill a default.
setup.step6: Click Save and connect (or Connect on the storage card). Microsoft will ask you to sign in and grant the requested scopes. McHarbor stores the returned refresh token encrypted and never shows it again.
setup.step7: Click Test connection to round-trip a probe object in the chosen drive.
